subject: Next steps: Aurora pricing & overage mechanics
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garner <alex@aurorahealthtech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Aurora pricing & overage mechanics

Thanks again for the time today, Alex — really useful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same page: 

Summary (from your side)
- Pilot expected monthly consumption: 1.5M – 3.2M active users generating ~250M–900M tokens/month.
- Burst profile: periodic spikes up to ~3x baseline for onboarding/test weekends (2–3x for 6–12 hour windows).
- Target procurement band: ~$7k–$12k / month for the initial pilot phase (you indicated you need to show unit economics to the board).

Redwood proposal (high level)
- Target unit economics: $95 / 1M tokens for production calls (baseline).
- Pilot discount tier: $75 / 1M tokens for committed 3-month pilot >= 500M tokens total.
- Burst handling: automatic soft-burst allowance up to 1.5x quota (no charge beyond baseline for that window), additional burst billed at 1.5x baseline unit price.
- Overages beyond committed quota: charged at 1.5x baseline unit price, with option for seat-of-the-pants quota increase (see next steps).

Questions / open items for you:
1) Can you confirm the expected baseline monthly token commitment range for the pilot (low / expected / high)?
2) Does procurement require a formal SLA or is a pilot-level commercial memo sufficient?
3) Who should we include from your procurement/legal to circulate the MAP and the simple SOW?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll send a draft MAP + usage sample (attached) and a simple one-paragraph SOW for procurement to review.
- If you’re good with the high-level numbers, we can (a) lock pilot pricing for 3 months and (b) provision a soft burst window.
- Ben (cc’d) will run the quota sizing and confirm the burst allowance logic/limits.

Attached: Aurora-MAP-v2.pdf (draft MAP), aurora-usage-sample.csv (sample traffic distribution)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if that’s faster.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Alex Garner <alex@aurorahealthtech.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Aurora pricing & overage mechanics

Thanks Camila — appreciate the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Baseline commitment: we can commit to a pilot band of 400M–650M tokens over the first 3 months (so roughly 130M–220M tokens/month). Expected peak days could push us to ~600M tokens in a week during user onboarding.
2) Procurement: please include procurement@aurorahealthtech.com and our legal lead Laura Jones (ljones@aurorahealthtech.com). They’ll need the MAP + a short SOW to start internal review.
3) Unit economics: $75 / 1M tokens for pilot sounds promising. For board review I need a clear statement on worst-case overage exposure if we don’t increase quota during a spike (e.g., what’s the monthly bill if we hit 3x baseline for two days).

Two quick questions:
- How quickly can Redwood increase quota in-region if we request a temporary bump?
- Is there a hard rate limit per API key that would drop requests vs. allowing them through and billing overage?

If you can send a one-page summary with a couple of examples (billing math scenarios) I can share it with procurement/legal and the PM owning the rollout.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product | Aurora HealthTech
alex@aurorahealthtech.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: Aurora pricing & overage mechanics — need quota/ops input

Ben / Markus — forwarding Alex’s clarifying questions. Key asks:
- Confirm mechanics and turnaround for temporary quota increases (in-region).
- Provide a couple of billing scenarios (I started one below).
- Confirm how we enforce rate limits vs. allowing traffic through and billing as overage (they want to know whether requests are dropped at the API layer).

Draft billing scenarios (illustrative):
- Baseline: 200M tokens/month at $75 / 1M = $15,000/month.
- Short spike: 3x baseline for 48 hours (assume baseline/day = 6.67M tokens; 3x for 2 days adds ~26.7M tokens => ~26.7 * ($75/1M) = $2,002.5 extra) — seems small given their volumes, but their numbers can vary.
- Large sustained spike: if daily active doubles for a week (7 days) add ~140M tokens => additional ~$10,500 at standard pilot price or ~$15,750 if billed at 1.5x overage multiplier.

Operational notes for response:
- We should offer a documented temporary quota increase process: 1) customer requests via portal / CSM; 2) Redwood ops triage and commit within 2 hours for in-region capacity if available; 3) if capacity constrained, auto-fallback to compatible lower-cost variant, otherwise apply overage billing at agreed multiplier.
- Rate limit enforcement option: we support two modes — throttle (soft 429s after X RPS) or allow-through billing. For pilots, recommend allow-through + alerting and a soft-burst window.

Attaching updated MAP and usage sample. Output for Alex should be a short one-pager with these bullets + explicit examples he can hand to procurement.

Thanks — Camila

Attachments: Aurora-MAP-v2.pdf, aurora-usage-sample.csv
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garner <alex@aurorahealthtech.com>, Procurement <procure@aurorahealthtech.com>, ljones@aurorahealthtech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps: Aurora pricing & overage mechanics — one-pager + next steps

Alex / procurement / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a one-page summary of pricing and overage mechanics that you can circulate (excerpted below). Also included is the draft MAP and sample usage.

One-page summary (excerpt):
- Pilot commit: 500M tokens over 3 months (firm) => effective pilot rate $75 / 1M tokens.
- Soft-burst allowance: automatic up to 1.5x monthly quota within a rolling 72-hour window; no extra charge while within the soft-burst.
- Burst overage: usage beyond soft-burst billed at 1.5x pilot rate ($112.50 / 1M) — credited if customer upgrades to a committed tier within 14 days.
- Quota increase process: request via portal/CSM -> ops triage -> confirm within 2 hours if in-region capacity is available. If not, we’ll propose compatible fallback model or schedule provisioning.
- Rate limit modes: (a) throttle (429s) or (b) allow-through + overage billing (recommended for pilot).

Examples: (rounded)
- Scenario A (short spike): Baseline 200M/mo at $75/1M => $15k. 48h 3x spike adds ~27M tokens -> billed at pilot rate = ~$2K additional.
- Scenario B (sustained week-long spike): additional 140M tokens -> if billed as overage at 1.5x = ~$15.75k extra.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alex: confirm you’re comfortable with the pilot band (I’ll update the MAP to reflect the 500M 3-month commit if yes).
2) Procurement / Laura: review attached MAP + SOW; if ok, I’ll send DocuSign for signature (link below).
3) Ben/ops: please standby to approve a temporary quota bump within the 2-hour window once Aurora requests it.

Signing link (preview): https://www.docusign.com/aurora/DEAL-8342
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8342

If helpful, I can schedule a 20m call with procurement/legal to walk the one-pager live.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
